why: Every square ring of arrows turns to go the opposite way round (clockwise becomes anticlockwise and the other way). Figure 3 has rings anticlockwise, clockwise, anticlockwise, so the answer is clockwise, anticlockwise, clockwise: option 2. Options 3 and 4 have one inner arrow pointing the wrong way, so their inner ring does not go round in a circle.
trick: Follow each ring around once and say "clockwise" or "anticlockwise"; then check the inner ring too.
